set.body:
Phase G. Gates any production-support claim.

Current evidence, honestly summarized (the docs themselves are commendably candid — this is self-reported, not concealed):
- Synthetic shape fixtures slurm-25.05-v0.0.43 and slurm-26.05-v0.0.43, both deliberately retaining supportClaim: false (docs/fixtures/README.md:35-37).
- ONE actual-binary capture, slurm-25.05.6-v0.0.43-actual, from a disposable Docker controller. Its worker did NOT register, so it is not execution or accounting evidence (docs/compatibility.md:104-107); the job sat pending for resources and never ran.
- Second major family (26.05): never captured — the build retry hung on the Docker socket _ping (docs/acceptance/p5-site-scale.md:42-48).
- Real unprivileged site: never reached — the Trillium SSH probe died at auth, "No Slurm command ran, no job was submitted, and no version, cluster, account, partition, or policy fact was learned" (:52-60).
- CLI/REST differential parity: not run, no authenticated REST-enabled site.

docs/compatibility.md:99-101 requires two supported major-release families, local and SSH-agent differential conformance, and real-site smoke evidence. NONE of the three is met.

Plan:
- Run the failure campaign, not just the happy path.
- Threshold for a PRODUCTION-SUPPORT claim: TWO real sites.
- Permit an earlier EXPERIMENTAL release provided every capability is explicitly marked verified / experimental / unsupported / untested.
- Ship a capability-by-version matrix. It is far more trustworthy than a blanket "supports Slurm".

Coordinates with existing beads rather than replacing them: P7.1 (capture harness), P6f.5a (sacct array fixture), P6f.33a (squeue absence transcript), P5 (site scale).
set.title: P8.G4: Capability support matrix and two-site qualification
